basis: Owner-authorized definitive retirement. Local journey acceptance is not final Foundation, CI or release acceptance.

journeys.journey: Choose an authorized business and reassess eligible owner authority
journeys.spaBoundary: /workspaces; reassessment remains an existing Laravel effect endpoint
journeys.cutover: WorkspaceController@index serves only the unified SPA shell/resource. Legacy list rendering is unreachable. Links from remaining legacy pages cross through native document navigation. Selected business/context/source destinations remain native until their own cutover.

journeys.journey: Create one classified business, retain uncertain original command, and continue to Goals
journeys.spaBoundary: /business/start; Laravel retains the atomic writer and next-journey redirect
journeys.cutover: BusinessContextController@start serves only the unified SPA. The previous Context creation presentation is unreachable. The existing creation key, SQL writer, transaction and non-JSON redirects are preserved. Successful creation continues to canonical Goals in the same unified SPA document; this is not acceptance of the whole advertiser group.

journeys.journey: Choose business goals, priority and per-goal outcomes; review conflicts and saved state without repeating uncertain writes
journeys.spaBoundary: Canonical editor and saved review use the shared Vue Router; Laravel retains the existing writer and scoped contextual reads
journeys.cutover: Canonical HTML routes contain only the unified shell and no business projection. The former Business/Goals Vue renderer and locale adapter are deleted; behavior tests exercise the actual SPA editor. Existing opt-in proof URLs reuse this renderer and shared entry; their production flag is not enabled. Business context, sources and account/security destinations remain native boundaries pending their cutover. Final Foundation, remote CI and B/C/device acceptance remain separate.

journeys.journey: Edit classified business name/type, request explicit authority, replace target markets, and replace or clear Current Intent with independent drafts and CAS review
journeys.spaBoundary: Canonical context screen in the shared SPA; existing Laravel continuation remains authoritative and exits natively only for un-migrated destinations
journeys.cutover: BusinessContextController no longer renders a legacy page. The former Pages/Business/Context renderer is moved into the SPA feature without any legacy imports; its component requirements remain tested. Existing native redirects are preserved; JSON commands acknowledge the same original writers. Memory-only Workspace/form drafts survive same-document suspension and clear on terminal document closure. Sources/Object Purpose and authentication/internal destinations remain pending; this is not complete advertiser or final Foundation/CI acceptance.

journeys.journey: Switch the application language using the existing encrypted locale cookie
journeys.spaBoundary: Shared Laravel HTTP command; no additional Vue application
journeys.cutover: JSON acknowledgement added for the unified SPA; existing native/legacy cookie and redirect contracts remain. Arabic/English direction and creation draft retention were exercised in Chromium.
